facts.fact: A YouGov survey reports that exercising more is the top New Year's resolution for Americans for 2026.
facts.quote: puts exercising more as the top resolution for Americans for 2026.

facts.fact: Tucson Strength owner Danny Sawaya says he has been owning a gym for 15 years.
facts.quote: now 15 years into owning a gym

facts.fact: A My Protein survey conducted in 2022 polled several hundred people about New Year gym habits.
facts.quote: surveyed several hundred people about this in 2022

facts.fact: In the My Protein 2022 survey, over a third of respondents signed up for some type of gym membership for the New Year.
facts.quote: While over a third signed up for some type of gym membership for the New Year

facts.fact: In the My Protein 2022 survey, 34% of people who signed up for a gym membership had stopped using it by December.
facts.quote: by December 34% had stopped using those memberships.

facts.fact: In the My Protein 2022 survey, over a quarter of people stopped using their gym membership after just 6 months.
facts.quote: Over a quarter stopped after just 6 months.

facts.fact: According to KGUN 9, Arizona law allows people to cancel a gym membership by email, mail, or through the gym's website.
facts.quote: Arizona law allows you to cancel your membership through email, mail or the gym's website.

facts.fact: The KGUN 9 article was published on January 1, 2026, at 9:51 AM Mountain Time.
